verdict.rationale: Approval workflows are a fair question for a feature-flag platform, but the evidence pack never documents approvals, reviews, or change requests on production gate changes. The related items cover SSO/SCIM access management, environment-tier isolation, and CLI use in CI/CD pipelines. These are adjacent controls or user-side workarounds, not a product-enforced approval gate, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live
